confirmed.detail: CHARGE/EXTRA_FUNCTION/FIRE_PROJECTILE/MODE directly dispatch capability actions without stage. Check actual stack before capability resolution/processor. Returning false still allows armor fallback: armor entry hooks separately required.

Curios keybind opens ContainerProvider(null), yielding same handnull menu as physical table45. Check actual Curios tablet47 before opening and retain its required tier for current menu after opening/removal/downgrade.
PacketHandler activate_archangel lambda calls static fireVolley directly, outside capability helper and ordinary use/attack hooks.
Mutates held Density/VoidRing GEM_DATA without stage. Actual hand/stack is supplied by context.player(); deny mutation without clearing stored components.
Delegates ItemStack.inventoryTick, covered by generic inventory wrapper; attributes have a separate path.
Independently calls IExposesCurioAttributes. Arcana supplies projecte:arcana_flight CREATIVE_FLIGHT. Filter newly returned modifiers and reconcile already-applied modifiers after team/stage changes.

Overrides onItemUseFirst, not useOn, and permits nullable-player direct mutation. Patched1.21.1 ItemStack declares both wrappers. Ordinary RightClickBlock already protects player path; direct/fake/unattributed callbacks need native guards.
InternalAbilities/fire/protection predicates can act before inventoryTick. Filter each actual candidate by actual player policy, while allowing native updateAttribute cleanup to continue.
Direct HEAD/CHEST views bypass hotbar predicates. Armor agent owns those hooks. Cancelling the whole tick would leave stale modifiers.

limits: Generic inventoryTick does not remove already-applied equipment/Curios attributes on team/stage changes; reconcile ProjectE-derived modifiers without unequipping or changing stack data.
Already spawned projectile/entity/world effects remain separate from initial guarded dispatch; do not claim universal protection.
Direct capability API calls outside reviewed vanilla/packet/passive dispatch remain addon-specific.
No fullpack optional dispatch, client UI, Survival or TPS benchmark was run.
